notes.title: 📜 Patch Notes 1.1.02
notes.notes:
[b]✨ Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a Restart button, allowing players to restart the match from the in-game menu (ESC).
[*] Dodge Roll now allows you to evade the lethal attack from Spirit of Death (if you have stamina).
[/list]

[b]⚖ Balanced[/b]

[list]
[*] Slightly increased enemy respawn time.
[*] Corrupted Jeremiah now spawns a number of Spirit of Death enemies depending on the difficulty.
[*] Reduced the number of Spirit of Death per round.
[/list]

[b]🛠 Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you would only obtain common cards.
[/list]

notes.title: 📜 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
✨ Features

[list]
[*] The FindSession system now correctly displays host name, difficulty, and playtime.
[*] Added feed for mini-boss and ally eliminations.
[/list]

⚖ Balanced

[list]
[*] Samurai: Increased Triple Shoot base damage 30 → 40.
[*] Gaucho: Feint attack now hits 2 → 3 times.
[*] Lakota: Increased Rain of Arrows AOE radius 250 → 500, reduced base damage 36 → 22.
[/list]

🛠 Fixed

[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues when tracing targetable abilities. (Exorcist, Lakota)
[*] Fixed bug where targetable abilities sometimes failed to deal damage. (Exorcist, Lakota)
[*] Fixed translation errors.
[*] Updated bow charge/shoot sounds.
[*] Fixed global playback of the drinking water sound.
[/list]

notes.title: Lighthouse of the Souls — Early Access Launch Today!
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to launch [i]Lighthouse of the Souls[/i] in [b]Early Access[/b]! [/p][p]Explore the Cemetery zone, face its horrors, and begin cleansing the corruption of the island. [/p][p]We truly hope you enjoy playing and immersing yourself in this dark world. Your feedback is essential — it will help us refine, improve, and make [i]Lighthouse of the Souls[/i] even better. [/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey with us! <3[/p]

notes.title: Open Beta [29-31/08]
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]First of all, a huge THANK YOU to everyone who tried out our game! 🫶 It makes us super happy to see people from all over the world playing it.[/p][p]We’ve also been reading through all your feedback, ideas, and suggestions. Based on that, we’ve made some big changes to the [b]core of the game[/b], [/p][p]Our goal is to make the gameplay smoother and easier to pick up, while still keeping the challenge and intense combat that define it. ⚔️🔥[/p][p]And now… we’re opening up the [b]Open Beta[/b] of the full game! 🎉 You’ll be able to try out:[/p][list][*][p]The new core gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]All the characters (including the secrets)[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer mode[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for all the support — can’t wait to see you in the beta! 🚀[/p][p]— The Lots Team[/p]

notes.title: Difficulties, Dynamic Weather and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]UI / Gameplay Flow[/b]
[list]
[*] Added map selection and difficulty selection to the UI.
[*] To unlock difficulty, you must clear the map on the previous level.
[*] Three difficulties have been set: Casual, Normal, and Hardcore.
[*] Added rankings for each difficulty.
[/list]

[b]Characters & Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two characters: Gaucho and Shaolin Monk.
[*] Corrupted can now dodge arrows.
[*] Enemies now have the armor attribute.
[*] Significantly increased enemy detection radius.
[*] Modified the character tab stats.
[/list]

[b]Combat & Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified the way enemies spawn (we now have a more powerful system).
[*] Arrow tracking now begins before the charge is complete.
[*] Added an end point to indicate the end of arrow tracking.
[*] Fixed a bug with health regen that caused it to stack instead of adding up.
[/list]

[b]World & Environment[/b]
[list]
[*] Added dynamic weather (it can now rain).
[*] Weather has been modified on all maps.
[/list]

notes.title: Smooth gameplay!
notes.notes:
[h3]Gameplay Improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*] Global and friend Ranking, by points and time! ¿Who is the best? ¿Who is the fastered?
[*] Implement Character tab, can you upgrade the rank to get a powerful passive?
[*] Now when you die, you go to heaven. (Or when Tomas dies :v)
[*] A tracer was added for the bow. (It's like a reticle but more fun)
[*] A combo time was added, so that it is more fluid to do a combo.
[*] A running attack was added, when you are running and attacking.
[*] Base damage of enemies was reduced, but their progression was considerably increased.
[*] Now the boss is a challenge
[/list]


[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] A tutorial was added for the handling of inputs,
[*] Various bugs (Stats of items, boss, and others)
[*] Translation errors
[*] Environment optimization. (You should notice an increase in your FPS.)

[/list]

¿Are you able to rescue the souls of humanity?




[h3]Bad day?[/h3] Think how lucky our friend was.

notes.title: Our first week
notes.notes:
Hello! We wanted to let you know what we've been working on this past week.
The list is long.
But we want to give you a summary, our priority is to focus on the gameplay, making it feel good to kill these enemies, from all points, the sound, the quality, the difficulty, etc.
Also, we like to share, so we've added the leaderboards so you can compete with your friends or globally for better positions.

- Better Gameplay (fix animations, added new armors, weapons, etc)
- We added the Tab Character (Complete tasks and upgrade your range to unlock powerfull abilities) 
- HighScore Leaderboard 
- BestTime Leaderboard 
- More enemies and more aggressive
- Update 90% Sounds, like footstep, bow, etc
- Fix animations
- Fix gameplay bugs

There's still a lot of work to do in the demo, and we'll keep improving it, we appreciate your patience and even more that you choose our game to have fun!

Thanks for play!

LOTS Teams
